claims.claim: The Product Intelligence CLI (cli.py) remains the sole Human-facing CLI exposing exactly evidence, catalog, ask, discover, and decide without aliases or secondary entry points.

The decide command accepts only --query, repeated --platform (shopee/tiktok), --cdp-endpoint, optional --shortlist-size, --actor, and --decided-at, rejecting duplicate single-value options with exit code 2 and introducing no unapproved controls.

Shared live discovery helper _run_live_discovery executes the exact TASK-146 discovery composition and completes browser cleanup before stderr preview rendering; discovery failure, cleanup failure, or empty shortlists abort before any human prompt or approval/queue action.

Exact OrchestrationResult preview is rendered to stderr, followed by bounded sequential reading of 1-based shortlist position and exact APPROVE/REJECT decision token from stdin; EOF, invalid position, or unrecognized tokens fail closed with no machine score or rank inference.

The selected position forwards the exact in-memory RankedCandidate by object identity to TASK-096 create_approval_record with the explicit decision, actor, and parsed datetime, without reconstruction or serialization.

REJECT skips enqueue and performs zero queue filesystem writes; APPROVE delegates once to enqueue_approval with default canonical paths, preserving idempotency, tasks.txt durability, completed.txt preservation, and no ingestion execution.

Successful output returns exactly approval and queue JSON with bounded projection; ApprovalError, interactive representation errors, OSError, and application errors fail sanitized with zero traceback or cause leakage.

In-memory decision implementation creates no persistent shortlist or approval records, no RankedCandidate codecs, no direct queue file operations, no AgentController execution, no catalog mutation, and no P6 behavior.

Comprehensive unit and regression tests in test_product_intelligence_cli.py verify object identity forwarding, explicit human control, APPROVE idempotency, REJECT no-write, error boundaries, and CLI command structure without live network or CDP dependencies.

Updated docs/POST_M4_P5_HUMAN_FACING_SURFACE.md and docs/POST_M4_PRODUCT_INTELLIGENCE_ROADMAP.md document P5.2 CLOSED by TASK-146, P5.3a candidate status for TASK-147, P5.3b/P5.3c unimplemented, P5 CURRENT / IN PROGRESS, and P6 not current.
